title: Technical SEO Triage
summary: Inspect a bounded site sample, identify supported technical SEO issues, and prioritize the few fixes most likely to change crawl, index, or page behavior.

required_inputs.description: The site URL or origin whose technical SEO state should be triaged.

steps.instruction: Define a representative, bounded URL sample from known site structure, user input, or available discovery evidence.
Inspect current runtime cost and authorization for the planned sample and provider-backed checks.
Inspect accessible status, redirect, canonical, metadata, structured, rendering, and linking signals that do not require broader paid checks.
Run only authorized provider checks that can confirm or reject a material issue in the sample.
Group observations into supported issues, suspected issues, unaffected scope, and unknown scope without extrapolating the sample to the full site.
Return the highest-value supported fixes with severity, confidence, affected sample, evidence, impact, owner, and verification method.

evidence_requirements: Every issue identifies the observed URL sample and evidence source.
Site-wide claims are made only when the evidence covers the full claimed scope.
Severity and impact are reasoned separately from confidence.
Verification methods state what observable change would confirm the fix.
stop_conditions: Stop or narrow the sample when broad crawling would exceed authorization or cost bounds.
Stop private-account diagnosis when no authorized first-party source is connected.
Return an empty completed diagnostic when the supported checks find no material issue.
completion_criteria: The inspected sample and its limits are explicit.
Each reported issue has severity, confidence, scope, evidence, intervention owner, and verification method.
The result contains no more than five prioritized fixes and may contain fewer when evidence does not support five.
Unknown and unaffected scope are not presented as fixed.

bounds.sample_guidance: Prefer a representative URL sample and three to five material fixes over an exhaustive crawl or a padded issue count.
